visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #2B2B2B for all delineations. Never use box-shadows for elevation, rely on border and background lightness.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-md for UI elements (buttons, inputs), rounded-none for layout panels.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for this IDE setup. Keep it solid and opaque to ensure maximum legibility and performance.

layouts.app_shell: h-screen w-screen flex flex-col bg-[#0D0D0D] text-white overflow-hidden text-sm font-sans
layouts.header: h-14 flex-none border-b border-[#2B2B2B] bg-[#141414] flex items-center justify-between px-4
layouts.left_sidebar: w-64 flex-none border-r border-[#2B2B2B] bg-[#141414] flex flex-col overflow-y-auto
layouts.center_canvas: flex-1 bg-[#050505] overflow-auto relative flex flex-col
layouts.right_sidebar: w-72 flex-none border-l border-[#2B2B2B] bg-[#141414] flex flex-col overflow-y-auto

components.buttons: Flat, text-sm, px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md. Primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white. Secondary: bg-[#1F1F1F] hover:bg-[#2B2B2B] text-gray-200 border border-[#2B2B2B].
components.inputs: bg-[#0D0D0D] border border-[#2B2B2B] rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-sm focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none text-white
components.tabs: Use simple flex containers with text-sm. Active tab: border-b-2 border-blue-500 text-white. Inactive: text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200.
components.accordion: For left sidebar categories (Navbars, Heroes, etc). Use border-b border-[#2B2B2B]. Header has text-xs uppercase tracking-wider.
components.color_picker: Right sidebar needs HEX, RGB, HSL inputs and alpha slider. Use grid-cols-4 for small inputs.
components.drag_drop_items: In left sidebar: rounded bg-[#1F1F1F] border border-[#2B2B2B] p-2 flex items-center gap-2 cursor-grab hover:border-gray-500 transition-colors.

motion.micro_interactions: Fast and snappy. 150ms ease-in-out for color/border transitions. No bouncy animations. The tool should feel immediate.
motion.panels: If collapsible, use 200ms ease transition on width.

accessibility.contrast: Text against #141414 and #050505 must meet APCA or WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus: focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.data_testid: Mandatory on all tools, inputs, buttons (e.g., data-testid='tool-navbar-drag', data-testid='color-hex-input').

media.icons: lucide-react for all interface icons (layout, type, image, mouse-pointer, code, save, download, settings). Size 16px for UI tools, 14px for smaller actions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust IDE layout utilizing the app_shell structure.
Top Toolbar must contain: Logo/Title, Mode Toggle (Design/Code) styled like a segmented control, Import HTML button, Export Dropdown, Save/Load actions.

Left Sidebar must have an Accordion/Collapsible sections for: Structure (Containers, Sections, Columns), Typography (Headings, Paragraphs, Font Setup), Blocks (Navbars, Heroes, Cards with quantity selector), Toolbox.
Center Canvas needs to simulate a webpage. Wrap it in an iframe or a styled div with a max-width and background white (for the user's design), while the surrounding canvas bg is #050505.
Right Sidebar is the Properties Panel: Needs a Photoshop/Illustrator-style Color Picker UI (Hex, RGB, HSL, Alpha inputs) and a Gradient Mixer that outputs CSS linear/radial gradients.
Code Editor Mode: When toggled, replace Center Canvas with a Monaco-style code editor component showing HTML/CSS.
Use Manrope for all UI text, JetBrains Mono for code blocks and inputs that take code/hex values.
Avoid gradients in the UI itself. The UI must remain flat, dark, and highly functional like Framer or VSCode.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not center-align the app container. Text should flow naturally.
Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (no unnecessary purple/pink gradients, no soft blurry blobs in the background).
Use strict 1px borders and flat backgrounds for component separation.
Always add data-testid to interactive elements.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the canvas elements so they are valid HTML for export.
Ensure all input fields have properly styled focus states that match the dark theme.
Icons must NOT be emojis. Use lucide-react exclusively.
